main_text.head: ORATIO XII. DE DONO LINGUARUM COLLATO APOSTOLIS in prima Pentecoste.

head.i: Recitata à IOHANNE WELLERO pridie Pentecostes 29. Maij anno 1596.

main_text.p: VEteris, atque adeo, inde ab ipsis Apostolorum temporibus, confueti Ecclesiæ moris est, ut diebus hifce, folenni feftivitate, nec non fin gulari animorum devotione, admirabilis Spiritus Sancti super Apostolos effusionis memoriam repetamus & celebremus. Quæ confuetudo superstitionis, aut alterius cuiusdam ᾧ Διαθήκης[?] nomine à quoquâ fugillari Aristarcho usque adeo non debet; ut potius cuiusvis religione Christiani hominis maximū officium sit, eam sanctâ, religiosâque observatione approbare, approbatam posteris transmittere, sancteque colendam commendare. Maximè verò, nos, qui scholasticum vitæ genus sequimur, doctrinæ cœlesti, sacrosanctisque eius mysteriis rectius aliquanto &

page.notes: Woodcut frieze (floral ornament with a face) above the title; not text. Greek word after "cuiusdam" is printed in a slanted, hard-to-read form; the reading ᾧ Διαθήκης is doubtful and marked [?]. The printed word "eius" is set as "cius" in the scan; kept as printed in the form "eius" is a reading assumption, so it is given as eius above, and the printer's form may be "cius". Left edge shows faint show-through from the reverse page; ignored. The "&" at the line end is the printed ampersand "&".
